# openprovider_dns_records (Data Source)

Lists every record of a DNS zone, so a configuration can check for a record before it adds one.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openprovider_dns_records" "example" {
  zone_name = "example.com"
}

# Check for a record before it is added.
locals {
  has_www = anytrue([
    for record in data.openprovider_dns_records.example.records :
    record.type == "A" && startswith(record.name, "www")
  ])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `zone_name` (String) The name of the DNS zone (e.g., example.com).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The zone name.
- `records` (Attributes List) The records of the zone. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--records))

<a id="nestedatt--records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `records`

Read-Only:

- `creation_date` (String) The date and time when the record was created.
- `modification_date` (String) The date and time when the record was last modified.
- `name` (String) The name of the record, as OpenProvider lists it.
- `priority` (Number) The priority of an MX or SRV record, 0 for other records.
- `ttl` (Number) The time-to-live in seconds.
- `type` (String) The record type (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, ...).
- `value` (String) The value of the record.
